name: "Oceanic" Tri-Flavored Ice Cream
description: Upon use, increases DEF, Max HP, and HP restored by 8% for all allies in the next battle.
story:
The three best-selling flavors at "Oceanic" ice cream are: Aether, Phlogiston, and Ancient Dreamscape Fossil. Nobody knows what any of them actually taste like but that's all part of the marketing strategy.

"The strawberry flavor is a mature market, and so is the chocolate flavor. But Ancient Dream Fossil, that is a taste defined by us, a market created by us."
